This is a long technical inquiry regarding the distributed memory caching topology and event loop responsiveness under 2,000+ concurrent active WebSocket sessions. Can we verify that the Redis Pub/Sub adapter handles broadcast bursts without queue backpressure or unhandled promise rejections?
What are the main security guidelines for API rate limiting and token revocation?
